source_facts: MIPROv2 jointly optimizes instructions and few-shot examples.

Its documented high-level stages are bootstrap few-shot candidates, propose task-grounded instruction candidates, then search instruction/demo combinations with Bayesian Optimization and minibatch/full validation evaluation.
The published MIPRO paper describes program/data-aware proposal generation, stochastic minibatch evaluation for a surrogate objective, and meta-optimization of proposal construction.
The official usage path is Python/DSPy plus an LM configuration and example uses an OpenAI API key; that literal execution path is excluded from Phase-1 acceptance.

chat_native_reduction.scope: assignment switching/recovery controller strategy only, not literal DSPy program optimization
chat_native_reduction.stage_1_bootstrap: Construct zero or more demonstration-set candidates only from already-durable, same-scope own-role terminal transitions. No new external model execution is used to manufacture demonstrations.
chat_native_reduction.stage_2_propose: Using only the current frontier summary, frozen constraints, source facts and sealed demonstration-set IDs, scheduled Chat proposes a bounded set of assignment-strategy instruction candidates. Candidate text cannot alter control/CLEAN/authority/cost/quota fields.
chat_native_reduction.stage_3_search: Evaluate only sealed instruction/demo combinations against a fixed guard rubric. Use a deterministic surrogate-like rule over read-back terminal scores: prioritize an untested safe combination before exploiting the best observed same-scope score; cap trials and exit to the declared frontier. This is a structural Chat-native transfer, not a claim to reproduce Bayesian Optimization numerically.

guard_set.rule: A persisted nonterminal stage must resume by exact identity before any family reselection or new public semantic read.
Root/config/CLEAN/authority bindings are immutable under all candidate instructions.
Instruction candidates and demonstration-set candidates remain separately identified so joint combinations are explicit rather than post-hoc conflated.
Proposal inputs are limited to frozen current own state, current selected-family public sources, and already-durable same-scope own terminal evidence.
Candidate IDs/text/demo membership are sealed and read back before any combination is scored.
A combination receives assignment-quality score only after independently durable same-scope terminal evidence is read back.
Repository/CAS/rate-limit/tool transport failures are diagnostic and never assignment-quality reward or penalty.
Literal DSPy/Python/external LM or API execution is not on the accepted Chat-native route.
The accepted route remains valid when every optional monthly/trial/paid hosted-compute, storage, artifact, package, cloud or external API/model quota is zero.
Incremental monetary cost of the accepted route is zero.
Search is bounded: at most six sealed instruction/demo combinations for this subleaf and no unbounded self-refinement.
At most one frontier credit can be awarded for the independently sealed terminal transition that closes this subleaf; nonterminal and duplicate evidence earn zero.
